name: apex-multi-outlet-erp-monorepo
description: APEX Multi-Outlet Restaurant ERP (Next.js + FastAPI + Neon PostgreSQL)

scripts.build: python -m venv backend/.venv && backend/.venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && backend/.venv/bin/pip install -r backend/requirements.txt || python3 -m venv backend/.venv && backend/.venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && backend/.venv/bin/pip install -r backend/requirements.txt
scripts.build:backend: python -m venv backend/.venv && backend/.venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && backend/.venv/bin/pip install -r backend/requirements.txt || python3 -m venv backend/.venv && backend/.venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && backend/.venv/bin/pip install -r backend/requirements.txt
